description: Provides the current theme and functions to change it.

exposed.computedThemes: Object containing all parsed theme definitions.
exposed.cycle: Cycle between all or a subset of themes.
exposed.global: Reference to the global theme instance.
exposed.isSystem: Indicates if the current theme was resolved from the system preference (`prefers-color-scheme`).
exposed.name: Name of current theme.
exposed.setTransitionOrigin: Sets the origin of the next theme change transition. Accepts a pointer event (uses its coordinates) or an element (uses its center). Pass `null` to reset.
